answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing, each measured or read. (2) tester device.py _handle_run calls run_proof synchronously, and server.py wraps each shim's poke in one RLock (_locked_hook), so parallel asks from constrain serialize at the tester. (3) standing() in cairn.tools.base.validation reports proven, never sealed, red and moved.

bullets.text: The floor's cost came from moved seals, not a missing filter, and parallel runs serialize at the tester's lock. Reading seals makes the floor cheap and reproducible, but it collides with two teeth that want an unsealed proof run.
